title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control.
quote: aDN2 (antennal grooming, n = 3 flies, 34 trials) and MDN (backwards walking, n = 9 flies, 271 trials)
mapping_basis: Paper name MDN is the MANC type name MDN (literature synonym DNp50); line SS03131 is listed for MDN in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 640 nm laser focused on the neck connective, 21 uW, 5 s on / 10 s off
sensory_condition: tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill; dorsal thorax opened for two-photon imaging of cervical connective; only trials with walking before stimulus analysed
penetrance: backward walking probability rises during stimulation (Fig. 2a)
notes: Backward walking classified from ball velocity <= -1 mm/s; coded yes for all leg pairs per PROTOCOL section 3 convention. Flies were walking before stimulation (trial selection), so the result is a switch from forward to backward walking. Paper line name 'MDN-spGAL4 (MDN3)'; Supplementary Table 2 lists SS03131 = VT023490-p65.AD; VT44845.GAL4DBD. The paper names no off-target cells for this line.

title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control.
source_locator: Fig. 4d (black traces, intact); Results 'Behavioural requirement of DN recruitment'

mapping_basis: Paper name MDN is the MANC type name MDN (literature synonym DNp50); line SS03131 is listed for MDN in driver_lines.csv.

title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control.
source_locator: Fig. 4d (blue traces, headless); Results 'Behavioural requirement of DN recruitment'; Supplementary Table 5
quote: we found that the activation of MDN in headless flies still drove backwards walking
mapping_basis: Paper name MDN is the MANC type name MDN (literature synonym DNp50); line SS03131 is listed for MDN in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 640 nm laser, 21 uW, aimed at anterior dorsal thorax, 5 s
sensory_condition: decapitated, neck sealed with UV glue, on spherical treadmill
penetrance: backward walking probability not different from intact (P = 0.265)
n_flies_note: 10 trials per fly; same flies as the intact record

title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control.
source_locator: Extended Data Fig. 10b (legend and panel); Discussion; Supplementary Table 6
quote: Amputation of the hind legs is sufficient to prevent flies from walking backward upon MDN optogenetic stimulation.
mapping_basis: Paper name MDN is the MANC type name MDN (literature synonym DNp50); line SS03131 is listed for MDN in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 640 nm laser, 21 uW, 5 s; 10 trials, 25 s apart
sensory_condition: intact head, tethered on spherical treadmill, hind legs bilaterally amputated at tibia-tarsus joint
coordination_notes: Authors conclude MDN-driven backwards walking only depends on active movements of the two hindlegs
penetrance: backward displacement abolished after hind-leg amputation (P = 0.010 intact vs amputated; amputated MDN vs amputated control n.s., P = 0.068)
n_flies_note: amputated n = 5; same-line intact flies before amputation n = 4 (walked backward)
notes: Preparation 'other' = intact fly with hind legs amputated. Legs are unclear because only ball displacement was measured; the legend attributes residual backward displacement to struggle-associated noise. The intact pre-amputation flies (n = 4) walked backward like the other intact MDN records and are not recorded separately.

title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control.
source_locator: Extended Data Fig. 5a (black traces, intact); Results 'Network size predicts behavioural necessity'; Supplementary Video 4 part 2
quote: DNp42 has monosyaptic connections to 29 other DNs and triggers backing up in intact animals
mapping_basis: Paper name DNp42 is the MANC type name DNp42; line SS57807 is listed for DNp42 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 640 nm laser, 21 uW, aimed at anterior dorsal thorax, 5 s; 10 trials, 25 s apart; saline-filled holder
penetrance: forward velocity drops to about -1 mm/s during stimulation (intact vs headless P = 0.040)
notes: Text also calls this 'backwards retreat'. Measured only as fictive forward velocity (no leg tracking), so confidence is medium. Backing up coded yes for all leg pairs per the backward-walking convention. Methods say lines were chosen where 'a clean spGAL4 line was available'. Methods also say DNp42 could not be found in MANC; the name maps by the kit. Control flies were Canton S.
